The '''Mirial Adepts''' were an organization that [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], was a member of. Unduli had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] Adepts, an honor given to only the wisest warriors.<ref name="SW:TCW:H&VFB" />
